message.content: {"note_claim": "The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 99-year lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "the UK would hand over sovereignty of the islands to Mauritius, while retaining control of the military base on Diego Garcia. It would lease back Diego Garcia for a period of 99 years - at an average cost of £101m a year.", "reason": "The BBC article directly states the sovereignty transfer to Mauritius and the 99-year lease-back of Diego Garcia, with the base's operations secured, matching the note's claims."}

parsed.note_claim: The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 99-year lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: the UK would hand over sovereignty of the islands to Mauritius, while retaining control of the military base on Diego Garcia. It would lease back Diego Garcia for a period of 99 years - at an average cost of £101m a year.
parsed.reason: The BBC article directly states the sovereignty transfer to Mauritius and the 99-year lease-back of Diego Garcia, with the base's operations secured, matching the note's claims.
